name: sparx — Interior (E-Design)
tagline: A bright, friendly template for online interior e-design — book consults from day one.
description: A bright, friendly interior-design site for online e-design studios — a warm coral palette, a teal accent and a modern sans, built around a HOW-IT-WORKS story and flat-fee packages. Installs a working booking flow: a real menu of consults and packages (free consult, single-room e-design, colour, layout, room refresh), three designers you book by name with their own hours, and shoppable, affordable e-design. Ships as "Room & Co." for everyday homeowners.
